input:
We want to deploy a custom sched_ext BPF scheduler on Linux 6.18 LTS for a flagship mobile SoC with big/little/prime clusters. On first load test we see:

  [scx] sched_ext: BPF scheduler watchdog timeout; ejecting scx_sched
  [scx] Reverting to CFS

The kernel auto-recovers but the scheduler drops off. What SCX_WATCHDOG_MAX_TIMEOUT constraint must the BPF program honor? What is the recommended bring-up pattern (compare against scx_rusty / scx_lavd reference implementations), and what ftrace / bpftool commands capture the last dispatched state before watchdog trip?
